The woman remains on the left and speaks softly with restrained emotion while
the wandering swordsman listens. He then replies calmly while she listens.
Only subtle lip movement, blinking, breathing and gentle wind movement.
Fixed medium two-shot, no camera movement, no scene change.

[0-4s] The camera holds a medium two-shot across the café table. The blonde woman rests her chin lightly on her hand and looks at the anime girl with a curious smile. The anime girl leans forward, gives a small excited wave, and says in Mandarin Chinese with a cheerful voice: “这个草莓冰茶好神奇，我才喝一口，就感觉整个人都亮起来了。”

|

[4-8s] The camera slowly pushes closer while keeping both characters in frame. The blonde woman blinks, smiles wider, and glances at the red drink. She replies in Mandarin Chinese with a soft amused voice: “可能是太甜了，不是魔法。” The anime girl pauses for a tiny beat, then looks down at the drink with serious curiosity.

|

[8-12s] The anime girl gently touches the straw, then looks back at the blonde woman. She says in Mandarin Chinese with a playful but sincere tone: “可是你们人类好厉害，连普通饮料都能让人心情变好。” Her hand gesture stays small and natural, and the drink remains stable on the table.

|

[12-16s] The blonde woman laughs quietly, lifts her coffee cup slightly without drinking, and answers with a teasing smile: “那是因为你今天心情本来就不错。” The anime girl blushes a little, smiles awkwardly, and lowers her raised hand. Soft sunlight flickers across their hair and the tabletop.

|

[16-20s] The camera settles into a closer two-shot. The anime girl looks at the coffee cup, then back at the blonde woman, and says with hopeful curiosity: “那下次，我可以也试试你的咖啡吗？” The blonde woman looks at her warmly and raises an eyebrow, amused. Both characters hold eye contact and smile as the café ambience continues.
